title: Service offer
description: One entry of the venture's service catalogue, at service-delivery/offers/<id>.json (route service-delivery/offers/[id]): a named service with its outcome, what it includes and excludes, how it is priced and how long it takes. It follows ITIL 4 service catalogue management and APQC PCF 5.1.2 (develop service delivery strategies). The service-delivery function owns it, and only the service-delivery agent (role service-delivery-agent) or a person writes it. Publishing an offer or its price outside the venture is a public-commitment decision.

id.description: The offer's id, the file name without .json

outcome.description: What the client has at the end, in one sentence

includes.description: The deliverables and activities in scope

excludes.description: What is out of scope, said plainly so a change request can point to it

price_model.description: How it is priced. Time and materials only when scope cannot be defined

price.description: The list price, or the rate for time and materials, or null when quoted per client

duration_days.description: The usual length from start to acceptance, in days

prerequisites.description: What the client must provide before work starts

runbook.description: Where the offer's delivery runbook is, as a venture path

product.description: The product card this offer belongs to, by id, when the venture keeps one

status.description: offered once a person has approved it for sale
